description: Save the warehouses an order takes its units from when its channel has no list of its own — orders made in the CRM, the customer portal, the shop's site API and channels without a list — in order of use; a shortage goes to the first warehouse that may go below zero. Send expected as get_stock_sources returned orders.warehouseIds; a list changed meanwhile is refused — read again. null removes the list (each product's primary warehouse again). Requires settings:write (owner/admin over OAuth or an explicitly scoped token). Applies to deductions from now on: no stock moves, nothing is sent to a marketplace, a line already deducted or placed by hand stays. Audited; saving the same list changes nothing. Confirm with the person first. Echoes the workspace.

expected.description: The current list exactly as get_stock_sources returned it in orders.warehouseIds (null when there is none). A list changed since is refused: read again.

warehouseIds.description: The new list in order of use: own warehouses or supplier showcases (kind own or supplier in list_warehouses), each once, at most 20. null removes the list, so such orders take from each product's primary warehouse.
